indicator_name: Import price indices by HS section, year on year (2016-2019)
description: Индексы цен импорта по разделам ТН ВЭД, к соответствующему месяцу прошлого года (2016-2019)
unit: index, same month of the previous year = 100
methodology: Taldau 19073959, second segment (no import/export dimension): month vs the same month of the previous year, 2016-01 to 2019-12 only -- the bridge to IMPORT_PRICE_INDEX_BY_HS_SECTION (from 2020, December-based). Methodology amended in July 2017 (prices converted to tenge); check the level of 2016-2017 before chaining.
